input_manifest.scope: Existing preassembled FEM operator replay; u_prev=0; not new PDE time integration

protocol.ordering: Full/DC alternates positions across paired repeats
protocol.timing: sum of per-step maximum rank wall time, monitoring+local+coarse+CG+true residual
protocol.excluded: FEM generation, input loading/distribution, PETSc global matrix staging, extra audits
protocol.initialization: reported separately and added in secondary metric
protocol.coarse: 8-dimensional Galerkin, Allreduce assembly/RHS, redundant exact LU
protocol.scope: single-node fixed-eight-subdomain strong scaling; not multi-node/application end-to-end
